svg.text: Rasterisation: which pixels does a triangle cover?
Dots are pixel centres; a filled cell is one fragment.
l1, l2, l3: barycentric weights of the pixel centre
w: the clip-space w of each vertex
Dividing by w keeps textures from swimming on slanted floors.
A pixel is covered if its centre (x + 0.5, y + 0.5) is inside.
A pixel on a shared edge is drawn by exactly one of two
neighbouring triangles, never twice and never zero times.
Tiny triangles can cover no centre and vanish.
With MSAA several samples per pixel are tested instead.
